systems.system: WURI-Niger foundational identification system (f-ID) with unique identification number
systems.country_label: système d'identification de base (f-ID); numéro unique d'identification (NUI)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, de la Sécurité publique et de l'Administration du Territoire, World Bank financed (about USD 81 million); the Direction Générale de la Police Nationale is a partner structure
systems.tiers: Planned, national coverage in all communes of the 8 regions; an interoperability framework is to let service providers verify identity, with the national police and the Gendarmerie nationale listed among the bodies to benefit

note: Presentation of the civil identification project; police and gendarmerie appear only as future users of identity verification, and nothing is said of reports or cases recorded at a station.
